VOIP alert guide
Based on Amount Receivable, configured thresholds, usage, and recent snapshots.
CriticalAmount Receivable has reached or passed the configured Critical Balance.
WarningAmount Receivable has reached the Credit Limit but has not reached Critical Balance.
SafeNo configured warning or critical threshold is currently reached.
No thresholdNo explicit Credit Limit or Critical Balance is set; enabled fallback balance bands may still classify the client.
Usage >5030-minute usage is at least 50. Medium starts at 100 and High starts at 150.
Possible SpamSustained 30-minute usage is unusually high for that client and above its prior profile maximum.
New CriticalCritical now, but not critical in the comparison snapshot.
RemovedCritical in the comparison snapshot, but no longer critical now.
Inactive + UsageConfigured Inactive while still reporting non-zero 30-minute usage.
Usage historyShows one client row with usage and Amount Receivable for each snapshot posted today.
All includes every currently visible client. The eye icon shows or hides Inactive clients; the dedicated Inactive + Usage filter always remains available. New/Removed Critical compare against the previous available snapshot.

SMS Balance Rules
Positive balances are prepaid credit remaining. A negative balance is overdraft already consumed. Balance $0 is Critical only when no overdraft is available. If overdraft is available—even OD $1—the client moves to OD monitoring and OD exhaustion becomes the next Critical target. Remaining overdraft = Overdraft + Balance; for example, OD $100 and Balance −$90 leaves $10.

SMS balance status guide
Based on the current balance, overdraft, and client thresholds.
BlockedNo overdraft and balance is zero/below, or the available overdraft is fully exhausted.
CriticalBalance has reached zero without available overdraft/the configured Critical Balance, or a signed critical overdraft level has been reached.
WarningBalance has reached the Credit Limit but has not yet reached the Critical Balance.
Near thresholdBalance is within 10% above a configured warning or critical threshold.
Running on ODBalance is zero/negative while any overdraft remains. OD exhaustion is the next Critical target.
SafeBalance is above all configured thresholds and is not using overdraft.
No thresholdNo Credit Limit or Critical Balance is configured; blocked and overdraft safety rules still apply.
New Critical sequence: reaching zero with no OD records an event. If OD is then added, zero/negative balance enters OD monitoring without marking the client recovered. Reaching a signed critical OD level or OD Remaining zero records another New Critical event. When a posted payment removes overdraft, the normal Credit Limit, Critical Balance, and zero-balance rules resume. OD Remaining = Overdraft + negative Balance.

Users & Roles
Role is what a person can do. Modules is which tabs they can open. The two combine: a semi-admin with only VOIP keeps full semi-admin rights inside VOIP and cannot open the rest.
New logins start as Viewer with every module. Create the login in Firebase Console → Authentication → Users; it appears here after the first sign-in.

Balance Monitor VOIP Settings
Balance Check Reminder
Desktop reminder a few minutes after each snapshot slot, while this app is open. Follows the Default shift above, and stays quiet for a slot you already posted.
min after :00 / :30
No Threshold Balance Alerts
For clients without Credit Limit or Critical Balance. Uses Amnt Receivable.
Spam Detection (30m Usage)
Flags a client only when its 30-min usage jumps well above its own recent usual, measured in the client's own noise (robust std-devs), so a naturally spiky or steadily-growing client doesn't false-flag. Wide-gap catch-up readings are excluded.

Danger Zone
Delete snapshots saved from 12:00 AM through 11:59 PM today for one source. This can affect New Critical comparisons.
Wipe an entire Firestore collection — every stored day, not just today. Admin & semi-admin.
Clear the Critical History tab — the separate record of every client that hit Critical Balance. Snapshots are not affected. Admin only.
Clear the Flagged Spam History tab. Possible Spam detection and its baseline are not affected. Admin only.
Clear the No-Threshold Clients tab — the separate log of every client seen in a snapshot with no threshold set. Snapshots are not affected. Admin only.
Reset the Spam Baseline — wipes the usage_profiles collection and rebuilds each client's baseline from existing snapshots, skipping wide-gap (e.g. overnight) readings. Use this to clear a baseline polluted by accumulated usage. Snapshots and manual exclusions are not affected. You can optionally keep a date/time range so its samples are preserved as-is. Admin only.
Stats Settings
Settings for the Stats Monitor. Balance-monitor snapshots, alerts and spam baseline are managed separately in the main Settings.
Delete every Stats snapshot from the prior day currently used by Traffic vs Prev Day, then clear the comparison cache so today starts with No prior slot. Admin only.
Danger Zone
Wipe the entire stats_snapshots Firestore collection — every stored day, not just today. Balance snapshots, New Critical comparison and spam baseline are not affected. Admin & semi-admin.

Reset the spam-detection baseline?

This wipes the usage_profiles collection and rebuilds each client's baseline from your existing snapshots, skipping wide-gap readings (e.g. an overnight resume) so accumulated usage no longer pollutes it. Your stored snapshots and manual recurring-charge exclusions are not affected.

The old profiles cannot be recovered, but detection stays working using the rebuilt baseline.
